gloss: to move; to change one's residence

definitions.gloss: to move; to change one's residence
definitions.explanation: To relocate from one home to another. A formal word for moving house, commonly used in official and written contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧します。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧した。
examples.english: I moved to Osaka for work reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧したら、{二週間|にしゅうかん}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: After moving, please submit the notification within two weeks.

notes:
A formal word for changing one's residence, frequently seen on official forms and in administrative contexts. Less casual than {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}{届|とどけ}→転居届：10284_tenkyotodoke⟧: change-of-address notification
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}{先|さき}→転居先：29866_tenkyosaki⟧: new address, destination of the move
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: moving notification (sent to contacts)
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧: change-of-address postcard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧: to move (house) — everyday, conversational
- ⟦{移転|いてん}する→移転する：20210_itensuru⟧: to relocate — used for offices or businesses rather than personal homes
- {転|てん}じる: to move/transfer — broader, literary

REGISTER:
More formal than ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧. Used on ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧ forms, in official correspondence, and in written announcements. In casual conversation, ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ is preferred.
